paragraphs.text: The Thorn was a wizard and the main foe of Tempé , who fears him. He may also have been a Planeswalker.

The Thorn works the storm lines and the death pools, possibly referring to red and black mana. Tempé won the magical firesword Soulslayer from the Thorn in a duel before the Parting. The two were still in conflict as of the Mending of the Clan Tree .
